Retire fill-ins that upstream has caught up with

Source: R/source_corrections.R
retire_filled_corrections.Rd

A correction that filled a missing source value goes stale as filled_upstream_agrees once the source holds that same value (G7). This records a bake decision for each such correction, by the reserved decider "filled_upstream", so it leaves the stale view. Schedule it beside the data load. A fill-in where upstream holds a different value is a conflict and is never retired here.

Usage

retire_filled_corrections(
  config,
  con,
  source,
  dry_run = TRUE,
  dialect = "mssql"
)

Arguments

config

A master_config from read_master_config(), with sources.

con

A DBI connection to the warehouse.

source

Character. A declared source.

dry_run

If TRUE, the default, list what would be retired.

dialect

"mssql" or "duckdb".

Value

Invisibly, a list: correction_ids and recorded (an integer).

Details

Interim. Superseded by the HVTR registry.

See also

decide_corrections()
